subject.title: feat: add OpenClaw registry export bridge

question: Should ClawHub expose `buildOpenClawRegistryExport` as a stable root `clawhub-schema` API now, and should it target hosted catalog feeds, account/publisher feeds, or both?
rationale: The code is narrow and tested, but publishing a new root schema helper is a product/API contract choice that automation should not settle from implementation quality alone.

options.title: Confirm the bridge contract
options.body: Approve the public helper shape and intended feed scope before merge so downstream OpenClaw registry integration has a stable contract.

options.title: Keep it internal for now
options.body: Remove or avoid the root export until the registry bridge shape settles, reducing compatibility pressure from early consumers.

options.title: Pause behind feed API work
options.body: Wait for https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/pull/2948 to settle before deciding whether this bridge should remain separate.

recommendation.title: Confirm the bridge contract
recommendation.body: Approve the public helper shape and intended feed scope before merge so downstream OpenClaw registry integration has a stable contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The current catalog feed wire contract and hosted feed source files this helper builds on trace to this contributor's recent current-main work.
